net.sourceforge.hunterj.jdbc

Class StatementInvocationHandler

  • java.lang.Object
    • net.sourceforge.hunterj.GenericInvocationHandler
      • net.sourceforge.hunterj.jdbc.QueryResourceInvocationHandler
        • net.sourceforge.hunterj.jdbc.StatementInvocationHandler
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.lang.reflect.InvocationHandler, QueryContextAccessor

    public class StatementInvocationHandler
extends QueryResourceInvocationHandler
    StatementInvocationHandler is provided to java.lang.reflect.Proxy to create a proxy to a java.sql.Statement. The invoke(Object, Method, Object[]) method monitors calls to the target Statement. When a java.sql.ResultSet is created, it is stored within the JdbcQueryContext associated with the current query.
